subject: Re: MAP slip signals — priority ladder, revised MAP and escalation
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@helixmed.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: tom.espinoza@helixmed.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP risk: procurement hold impacting acceptance window

Sean / Laura —

Quick note from our side: procurement pulled the vendor vetting queue today and put our Redwood engagement on hold pending a short compliance follow-up (SOC2 evidence + vendor questionnaire). That blocks signature and therefore our acceptance window for the June 30 go/no-go.

We still want to move forward but need to understand the impact to the MAP and final delivery dates. Can you provide: a) a short mitigation plan, b) an updated MAP with prioritized feature waves, and c) any escalation path if procurement extends the hold beyond next week?

I attached the procurement request PDF they generated (procurement_timeline.pdf). Happy to take a quick call — Tom and I are available late morning.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Director of Product, HelixMed
alyssa.chen@helixmed.com

--
Attachment: procurement_timeline.pdf (PDF stub)

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@helixmed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP risk: procurement hold impacting acceptance window

Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and for sending the procurement note. Short answers up front: we can absorb a short hold without breaking the project, but we need to re-prioritize the MAP and set a clear priority ladder so HelixMed still gets business-critical capability first.

Proposed immediate steps (quick list):
- We’ll publish a revised MAP today (HLX_MAP_v3.xlsx) that splits acceptance into Wave A (core inference + logging), Wave B (integration plugins), Wave C (analytics).
- Offer an interim delivery path: if procurement needs more time, we can stand up a time-limited hosted instance for HelixMed (no long-term commitment) to validate functionality while signature is completed.
- If procurement extends beyond 10 business days, request an executive sync to consider a 2-week re-baseline and temporary commercial concessions.

I attached the MAP v3 (spreadsheet) and linked the shared Drive folder. Please review Wave A items first — we can aim to keep the original acceptance criteria for those.

Next steps: 30-min call today at 2pm PT? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and the MAP file.

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com

--
Attachment: HLX_MAP_v3.xlsx (XLSX stub)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-HelixMed-MAP

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@helixmed.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Espinoza <tom.espinoza@helixmed.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP risk: procurement hold impacting acceptance window

Thanks Sean — I appreciate the quick turnaround.

Quick context from procurement: the hold is procedural (additional vendor questionnaire + security point of contact confirmation). They said it could be cleared within 3–7 business days but did not promise a hard date.

We like the Wave A/B/C idea. For scheduling: can you map which acceptance tests remain critical for our June acceptance (the ones that would block go-live)? If we are realistic, procurement suggested a conservative acceptance date of July 14 if everything goes smoothly.

Can you also add a short "priority ladder" in the MAP that labels each feature as MUST / SHOULD / NICE-TO-HAVE? Procurement needs that to decide whether they can sign an interim SOW for just Wave A.

On the call at 2pm.

Best,
Alyssa

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@helixmed.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP risk: procurement hold impacting acceptance window — updated MAP snapshot

Alyssa — following up from our call. I uploaded a snapshot of the MAP with the priority ladder and the Wave A acceptance checklist. Key bullets:
- Wave A (MUST): core inference endpoint, token-level logging, basic SSO (SAML), and basic latency KPI (p95 < 250ms for 4k seq).
- Wave B (SHOULD): integrations (FHIR connector, SFTP patch), extended observability dashboards.
- Wave C (NICE-TO-HAVE): advanced analytics and model-tuning automation.

Action items for HelixMed (short):
1) Confirm Wave A items you consider MUST by EOD tomorrow.
2) Procurement to confirm if they can sign a Wave A interim SOW (Tom) or prefer a single SOW after vetting.

I also proposed a 2-week soft re-baseline (July 14 acceptance) as a contingency with no SLA credits yet — that would buy procurement time and let us ship Wave A to production earlier if procurement signs an interim SOW.

Call invite sent for Wed 09:00 PT (30 min). See MAP in the Drive.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

--
Attachment: HLX_MAP_v3.xlsx (XLSX stub)
Related link: HS-12345

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, seans_gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: potential 2-week re-baseline — exec clearance request

Laura / Execs —

We have a live procurement hold at HelixMed that is likely to push their acceptance date into mid-July. Sean and Marissa have proposed a 2-week soft re-baseline to July 14 to keep momentum and avoid an unhealthy rush to meet acceptance criteria.

Risks and proposed mitigations:
- Risk: extended procurement hole (>10 business days) leads to drift and resource contention. Mitigation: offer time-limited hosted instance and interim SOW for Wave A; escalate to execs if procurement cannot commit within 10 business days.
- Risk: perceived delivery slowdown may trigger credit/discount requests. Mitigation: limit concessions to temporary burst credits and do not offer SLA credits without Legal sign-off.

Request: executive sign-off to proceed with a 2-week re-baseline (July 14 acceptance) and approve the interim hosted instance offer. If approved I will coordinate a short exec sync with HelixMed procurement/legal to close the loop.

Please advise by EOD today so we can finalize messaging.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Tom Espinoza <tom.espinoza@helixmed.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Escalation: potential 2-week re-baseline — exec clearance request

Karthik / Sean —

We can accept a 2-week re-baseline to July 14 provided Redwood delivers two things: 1) a brief runbook that details the interim hosted instance operations and rollback plan, and 2) SOC2 evidence + the answered vendor questionnaire. Once we have those, procurement will expedite review and we can likely sign an interim Wave A SOW.

Also — please send the DocuSign link for the interim SOW and a short summary of commercial terms for Wave A. If legal still needs more time we will schedule an exec sync next week.

Thanks,
Tom Espinoza
Sr. Procurement Manager, HelixMed
Tom.Espinoza@helixmed.com
